highlights_headline: This unreleased 3.119.x line backports Apple 26.0 TFM support and fixes a missing WinUI projection DLL.

bullets.detail: Backports the 26.0 library and unversioned app target framework monikers to the 3.119.x servicing line.
Fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found by .NET 9 consumers.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM support.
